text:
Maya: Hey team — surge for APAC onboardings tonight. We have 3 customers with scheduled enablement sessions (one is on the renewal watchlist). Can someone cover office hours 22:00–02:00 UTC? Prefer someone who can demo Dedicated migration steps.
Liam: I can do 22:00–00:00 UTC, happy to run migration demo. @Maya will need handoff notes. :thumbsup:
Sofia: I can take 00:00–02:00 UTC. Will prepare a short checklist for renewal-risk customers.
Maya: Awesome — @Liam covers first half, @Sofia second. @Kai can you publish the agenda and handover doc?
Kai: On it. Drafting agenda in the shared doc: https://redwood.app/s/enablement-night-AG
Kai: Agenda draft:
- 22:05 quick intros
- 22:10 Dedicated migration checklist (Liam)
- 22:30 Q&A + runbook review (include rollback + fallback model variants)
- 23:00 break / handover notes
- 00:05 renewal-risk playbook (Sofia)
- 00:30 follow-ups & action items
Maya: Minor tweak — call out "rollback + fallback model variants" explicitly under runbook. Also add prompt set verification.
Sofia: Adding prompt set now and will attach to the doc.
Liam: Can someone create the calendar event and invite customers? @calendar-bot
calendar-bot: Event created: "Enablement Nightshift" — 2024-06-03 22:00 UTC → 2024-06-04 02:00 UTC. Invites sent: Acme Health (ACM-234), Kestrel Bio, NovaCare. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Please add a renewal flag on Acme Health — finance noted usage >70% pre-trial.
Sofia: Noted. I'll prep a tailored follow-up for Acme and add to action items.
Liam: I will record the demo and upload to /shared/enablement-recordings.
Maya: :raised_hands: One more — if any major blocker shows up, ping #eng-oncall and escalate.
Kai: Handover doc link published: https://redwood.app/docs/enablement/nightshift-handover.md
Sofia: Final checklist attached to the doc.
Maya: Great. Tag me if times or coverage change. Thanks all.
